items.prompt: The input contract accepts whole cents only. A source sends the decimal price text 12.345 dollars. What should this interface do?
items.explanation: 12.345 dollars is 1234.5 cents, outside a whole-cent input contract. Reject it or use a separately agreed conversion policy; do not silently invent rounding.

options.text: Discard the final digit as an undocumented default
options.why: That silently chooses a rounding policy the contract never approved.

options.text: Convert to float and assume whole cents are preserved
options.why: A float conversion does not remove the fractional-cent ambiguity.

options.text: Reject it until an explicit conversion policy is agreed
options.why: The value is outside the stated precision contract.

options.text: Choose the closest cent and omit the conversion rule
options.why: Nearest rounding is still a policy choice, not an implied contract.
